component.name: Shrink
component.summary: Resize images in batches to a format, a size or a file size

description.p: Shrink resizes any number of images at once. Add files, add a folder, or drop either onto the window, then say what the results have to be.

ul.li: Four constraints, each independently switchable: output format, longest edge, quality and a file-size ceiling
Recommendations across them: moving one control shows what the others would have to be to satisfy the whole set
Reads JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, TGA, ICO, PSD and Netpbm
Everything happens on the local disk; the program opens no network connection
A restrained light and dark theme that follows the desktop
